signal.entry: At closed hour t, C[t]>SMA168[t] AND C[t-1]<=SMA168[t-1]; long next hour open; require169 completed closes; no same-bar fill. At most one position.
signal.exit: C[t]<SMA168[t] queues next-hour-open full liquidation; protective stop and time deadline remain active. No short, pyramiding, trailing or profit target.
signal.priority: At each open adverse stop gap first; then pending signal/time exit, then pending BUY if allowed; intrabar low stop for held/newly-entered long; no optimistic extrema. Stop price frozen from fill, rounded down to.01. Terminal split close is forced and separately counted, never use subsequent split prices.

split_policy: Start each evaluation split flat with1000cash and independent original risk budget; use prior split prices solely as causal SMA warmup. Development/validation are diagnostics, not parameter selection. Never retune after validation/test. Previous test prices must not be read for code debugging before code/test/configfreeze. Forced terminalclose uses only segmentlastclose, costs applied. No pooling to hide split failure.
